verses.en: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
verses.pt: Ora, ao que é fraco na fé, acolhei-o, mas não para condenar-lhe os escrúpulos.
verses.en_web: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
verses.en_bbe: Do not put on one side him who is feeble in faith, and do not put him in doubt by your reasonings.

verses.en: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
verses.pt: Um crê que de tudo se pode comer, e outro, que é fraco, come só legumes.
verses.en_web: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
verses.en_bbe: One man has faith to take all things as food: another who is feeble in faith takes only green food.

verses.en: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
verses.pt: Quem come não despreze a quem não come; e quem não come não julgue a quem come; pois Deus o acolheu.
verses.en_web: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.
verses.en_bbe: Let not him who takes food have a low opinion of him who does not: and let not him who does not take food be a judge of him who does; for he has God's approval.

verses.en: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
verses.pt: Quem és tu, que julgas o servo alheio? Para seu próprio senhor ele está em pé ou cai; mas estará firme, porque poderoso é o Senhor para o firmar.
verses.en_web: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
verses.en_bbe: Who are you to make yourself a judge of another man's servant? it is to his master that he is responsible for good or bad. Yes, his place will be safe, because the Lord is able to keep him from falling.

verses.en: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
verses.pt: Um faz diferença entre dia e dia, mas outro julga iguais todos os dias. Cada um esteja inteiramente convicto em sua própria mente.
verses.en_web: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
verses.en_bbe: This man puts one day before another: to that man they are the same. Let every man be certain in his mind.

verses.en: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
verses.pt: Aquele que faz caso do dia, para o Senhor o faz. E quem come, para o Senhor come, porque dá graças a Deus; e quem não come, para o Senhor não come, e dá graças a Deus.
verses.en_web: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps the day, keeps it to the Lord; and he who takes food, takes it as to the Lord, for he gives praise to God; and he who does not take food, to the Lord he takes it not, and gives praise to God.

verses.en: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
verses.pt: Porque nenhum de nós vive para si, e nenhum morre para si.
verses.en_web: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
verses.en_bbe: For every man's life and every man's death has a relation to others as well as to himself.

verses.en: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.
verses.pt: Pois, se vivemos, para o Senhor vivemos; se morremos, para o Senhor morremos. De sorte que, quer vivamos quer morramos, somos do Senhor.
verses.en_web: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
verses.en_bbe: As long as we have life we are living to the Lord; or if we give up our life it is to the Lord; so if we are living, or if our life comes to an end, we are the Lord's.

verses.en: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
verses.pt: Porque foi para isto mesmo que Cristo morreu e tornou a viver, para ser Senhor tanto de mortos como de vivos.
verses.en_web: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
verses.en_bbe: And for this purpose Christ went into death and came back again, that he might be the Lord of the dead and of the living.

verses.en: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
verses.pt: Mas tu, por que julgas teu irmão? Ou tu, também, por que desprezas teu irmão? Pois todos havemos de comparecer ante o tribunal de Deus.
verses.en_web: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: But you, why do you make yourself your brother's judge? or again, why have you no respect for your brother? because we will all have to take our place before God as our judge.

verses.en: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
verses.pt: Porque está escrito: Por minha vida, diz o Senhor, diante de mim se dobrará todo joelho, e toda língua louvará a Deus.
verses.en_web: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”
verses.en_bbe: For it is said in the holy Writings, By my life, says the Lord, to me every knee will be bent, and every tongue will give worship to God.

verses.en: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, cada um de nós dará conta de si mesmo a Deus.
verses.en_web: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
verses.en_bbe: So every one of us will have to give an account of himself to God.

verses.en: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.
verses.pt: Portanto não nos julguemos mais uns aos outros; antes o seja o vosso propósito não pôr tropeço ou escândalo ao vosso irmão.
verses.en_web: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
verses.en_bbe: Then let us not be judges of one another any longer: but keep this in mind, that no man is to make it hard for his brother, or give him cause for doubting.

verses.en: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
verses.pt: Eu sei, e estou certo no Senhor Jesus, que nada é de si mesmo imundo a não ser para aquele que assim o considera; para esse é imundo.
verses.en_web: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
verses.en_bbe: I am conscious of this, and am certain in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean in itself; but for the man in whose opinion it is unclean, for him it is unclean.

verses.en: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
verses.pt: Pois, se pela tua comida se entristece teu irmão, já não andas segundo o amor. Não faças perecer por causa da tua comida aquele por quem Cristo morreu.
verses.en_web: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
verses.en_bbe: And if because of food your brother is troubled, then you are no longer going on in the way of love. Do not let your food be destruction to him for whom Christ went into death.

verses.en: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
verses.pt: Não seja pois censurado o vosso bem;
verses.en_web: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
verses.en_bbe: Let it not be possible for men to say evil about your good:

verses.en: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: porque o reino de Deus não consiste no comer e no beber, mas na justiça, na paz, e na alegria no Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: For the kingdom of God is not food and drink, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
verses.pt: Pois quem nisso serve a Cristo agradável é a Deus e aceito aos homens.
verses.en_web: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
verses.en_bbe: And he who in these things is Christ's servant, is pleasing to God and has the approval of men.

verses.en: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, sigamos as coisas que servem para a paz e as que contribuem para a edificação mútua.
verses.en_web: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
verses.en_bbe: So then, let us go after the things which make peace, and the things by which we may be a help to one another.

verses.en: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
verses.pt: Não destruas por causa da comida a obra de Deus. Na verdade tudo é limpo, mas é um mal para o homem dar motivo de tropeço pelo comer.
verses.en_web: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
verses.en_bbe: Do not let the work of God come to nothing on account of food. All things are certainly clean; but it is evil for that man who by taking food makes it hard for another.

verses.en: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
verses.pt: Bom é não comer carne, nem beber vinho, nem fazer outra coisa em que teu irmão tropece.
verses.en_web: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
verses.en_bbe: It is better not to take meat or wine or to do anything which might be a cause of trouble to your brother.

verses.en: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
verses.pt: A fé que tens, guarda-a contigo mesmo diante de Deus. Bem-aventurado aquele que não se condena a si mesmo naquilo que aprova.
verses.en_web: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
verses.en_bbe: The faith which you have, have it to yourself before God. Happy is the man who is not judged by that to which he gives approval.

verses.en: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
verses.pt: Mas aquele que tem dúvidas, se come está condenado, porque o que faz não provém da fé; e tudo o que não provém da fé é pecado.
verses.en_web: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
verses.en_bbe: But he who is in doubt is judged if he takes food, because he does it not in faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
